verdict.rationale: Xero automatically detects and flags duplicate bills (xero-docs-31), and its JAX AI reconciles and matches bank transactions (xero-docs-20). An official MCP server and AI Toolkit with OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain support (xero-docs-3, xero-docs-6, xero-probe-2) would let a custom agent read ledger data to build monitoring, but none of this amounts to a documented agent that watches the ledger and flags spend anomalies before close. Missing for 10: native spend-anomaly detection, duplicate detection beyond bills (e.g. bank transactions or journals), a documented agent-driven continuous ledger monitoring or pre-close review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
